description: S457 review: `lift` / `<each>` markup writes a call site's UNDECLARED attribute onto the expanded root of a component with no `props` block, so `srcdoc=it.d` would write row data into an iframe document — refused at the write. NOTE (S458 "D1"): this case was `declared-prop-srcdoc-each-lift-neg`, with `Fr` declaring `props={ srcdoc: string }`. Under D1 a DECLARED prop never reaches the root (§15.10), so that form writes nothing and correctly fires nothing (pinned by components/declared-prop-not-root-attr). The sink is still reachable through the undeclared fallthrough, which this case now pins in both `lift` and `<each>`.
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457) `srcdoc` in every form: "The refusal applies wherever such a write is emitted — including a call-site attribute written onto an expanded component root." Before S457: `setAttribute("srcdoc", it.d)`, Chromium ran the data.
